issues.title: fleet workers revert or edit files outside their brief (git checkout in the shared tree, main checkout)
issues.body:
What happened: a worker saw recorded reference PNGs modified against HEAD, took them for stale files and reverted them with git. Another implementer in a lead's worktree edited the main checkout's copy of its file (Edit run from the sl path's directory) and restored it with `git checkout --` in the main checkout.
Where: worker prime / fleet hook, brief text (ROOT).
Expected: the prime says git status against HEAD is the run's normal state, task text names ROOT and the worker edits only ROOT paths; git checkout/restore of files outside its brief is blocked.
Evidence: x2, 2026-11-13, versions 1.5.198, 1.5.215, claude-code.
Status at 1.5.215: agent texts forbid checkout and name Root (#670 covered fixers and reviewers); no hook blocks it and the prime does not say a dirty tree is the run's normal state.


Source: feedback inbox triage, 2026-11-14.

issues.title: orchestrator end moves .superlite/briefs/lead.md; later fleet spawn --for-review finds no standing note
issues.body:
What happened: orchestrator end in a backlog lead's worktree moves .superlite/briefs/lead.md into runs/; a later `fleet spawn --for-review` or build_prime there finds no standing note.
Where: orchestrator end; findings.standing_note reads briefs/lead.md.
Expected: lead.md stays in briefs/.
Evidence: x1, 2026-11-13, version 1.5.209, claude-code.


Source: feedback inbox triage, 2026-11-14.

"""Fix briefs name Root after PLAN and carry the tree rule after the Reviewed version line (#784)."""
import json
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace
import pytest
from test_plan_tools import SCRIPTS, make_plan
sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))
import findings  # noqa: E402

RULE = ("Edit only files under Root, by absolute paths; a copy elsewhere (the main checkout, the folder that holds sl) is not yours. "
        "`git status` showing files changed against HEAD is the run's normal state: never revert, restore or stash a file you did not change "
        "(`git checkout`, `git restore` and `git stash` are denied to workers).")


@pytest.fixture
def run(tmp_path):
    root = tmp_path / "repo"; sd = root / ".superlite"; (sd / "fleet" / "reports").mkdir(parents=True)
    plan = make_plan(sd, [{"id": "T1", "owns": "src/a.py", "tests": "fast"}], name="plan.md")
    def report():
        p = sd / "fleet" / "reports" / "FR1.json"
        item = {"file": "src/a.py", "line": 3, "problem": "p", "fix": "x", "tier": 1}
        p.write_text(json.dumps({"id": "W4", "label": "FR1", "status": "CHANGES_REQUESTED", "findings": [item], "valid": True}))
        return str(p)
    return root, sd, plan, report


def lines(sd, fid):
    return (sd / "briefs" / f"fix-{fid}.md").read_text().split("\n")


def check(ls, root):
    i = next(n for n, x in enumerate(ls) if x.startswith("PLAN="))
    assert ls[i + 1] == f"Root: {root.resolve().as_posix()}"
    j = next(n for n, x in enumerate(ls) if x.startswith("Reviewed version:"))
    assert ls[j + 1] == findings.TREE_RULE


def test_tree_rule_text():
    assert findings.TREE_RULE == RULE


def test_task_brief_names_root_after_plan(run):
    root, sd, plan, report = run
    findings.route(sd, plan, [report()], "/sl/sl")
    check(lines(sd, "F-T1-1"), root)


def test_coordinator_brief_names_root_after_plan(run):
    root, sd, plan, report = run
    (sd / "pool.json").write_text(json.dumps({"agents": [{"id": "W1", "busy": True, "current": "T1"}]}))
    findings.route(sd, plan, [report()], "/sl/sl")
    check(lines(sd, "F-C-1"), root)


def test_brief_text_without_root(run):
    root, sd, plan, report = run
    task = SimpleNamespace(id="T1", owns=["src/a.py"], tests="fast", cmd=None)
    item = {"id": "F-T1-1", "file": "src/a.py", "line": 3, "problem": "p", "fix": "x", "tier": 1, "label": "FR1"}
    ls = findings.brief_text("/sl/sl", plan, task, [item], 1, checkpoints=None).split("\n")
    assert not any(x.startswith("Root:") for x in ls)
    j = next(n for n, x in enumerate(ls) if x.startswith("Reviewed version:"))
    assert ls[j + 1] == findings.TREE_RULE

"""#784: the fleet task message names the run root right after PLAN=, except for an external-repo task."""
from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys

from test_plan_tools import SCRIPTS

sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))
import fleet_io  # noqa: E402
import plan_tools as pt  # noqa: E402


def plan(tmp_path, repo=None):
    out = ["# Plan", "**Goal:** test.", "", "Global constraints:", "- small", "", "```mermaid", "flowchart LR", "  T1[a]", "  T2[b]", "  %% taskgraph", "```", ""]
    out += ["### T1 thing · Complexity 1", "**Owns:** src/a.py, tests/test_a.py", "**Tests:** fast"] + ([f"**Repo:** {repo}", "**Repo test:** `pytest -q`"] if repo else []) + [""]
    out += ["### T2 other · Complexity 1", "**Owns:** src/b.py, tests/test_b.py", "**Tests:** fast", ""]
    p = tmp_path / "plan.md"
    p.write_text("\n".join(out), encoding="utf-8")
    return p


def root_of(p):
    return pt.stable_root(str(p)).resolve().as_posix()


def test_task_message_names_root_after_plan(tmp_path):
    p = plan(tmp_path)
    lines = fleet_io.task_message(p, ["T1"], "/sl/sl", "/sl").splitlines()
    i = lines.index(f"PLAN={p.resolve()}")
    assert lines[i + 1] == f"ROOT={root_of(p)}"


def test_batch_message_names_root_once(tmp_path):
    p = plan(tmp_path)
    lines = fleet_io.task_message(p, ["T1", "T2"], "/sl/sl", "/sl").splitlines()
    assert len([ln for ln in lines if ln.startswith("ROOT=")]) == 1


def test_haiku_message_names_root(tmp_path):
    p = plan(tmp_path)
    lines = fleet_io.task_message(p, ["T1"], "/sl/sl", "/sl", tier="haiku").splitlines()
    i = lines.index(f"PLAN={p.resolve()}")
    assert lines[i + 1] == f"ROOT={root_of(p)}"


def test_external_task_has_no_root_line(tmp_path):
    shared = tmp_path / "shared"
    shared.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", str(shared)], check=True)
    p = plan(tmp_path, repo=shared)
    msg = fleet_io.task_message(p, ["T1"], "/sl/sl", "/sl")
    assert not [ln for ln in msg.splitlines() if ln.startswith("ROOT=")]

"""#784: every fleet worker role is denied git checkout, git restore and git stash in the shared tree."""
import sys

import pytest

from test_plan_tools import SCRIPTS

sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))
import fleet  # noqa: E402
import fleet_roles as fr  # noqa: E402
import routing  # noqa: E402

CFG = routing.load_cfg()
DENY = ["Bash(git checkout *)", "Bash(git restore *)", "Bash(git stash)", "Bash(git stash *)"]


def test_git_deny_constant():
    assert list(fr.GIT_DENY) == DENY
    assert fr.TAIL == ["--disallowedTools", "AskUserQuestion", *DENY]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("role,tier", [("implementer", "sonnet"), ("implementer", "haiku"), ("fixer", "2"),
                                       ("package-reviewer", None), ("final-reviewer", None), ("checker", None),
                                       ("research", None)])
def test_every_worker_role_denies_git_tree_commands(role, tier):
    argv = fr.launch(role, tier, CFG)["argv"]
    i = argv.index("--disallowedTools")
    assert argv[i + 1] == "AskUserQuestion"
    assert all(d in argv[i + 1:] for d in DENY)
    assert argv.count("--disallowedTools") == 1


def test_writer_keeps_its_own_deny_list(tmp_path):
    argv = fr.launch("writer", None, CFG, output=str(tmp_path / "x.md"))["argv"]
    assert argv[-4:] == ["--disallowedTools", "AskUserQuestion", "Bash", "NotebookEdit"]
    assert argv.count("--disallowedTools") == 1


def test_lean_argv_keeps_each_deny_name_once():
    argv = fleet.lean_argv(fr.launch("implementer", "sonnet", CFG)["argv"], None, ["Bash(git stash)"])
    assert all(argv.count(d) == 1 for d in DENY)

"""#791: orchestrator end archives the run's briefs but leaves the lead's own briefs in briefs/."""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

from test_plan_tools import SCRIPTS

sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))
import backlog_brief as bb  # noqa: E402
import findings  # noqa: E402
import orchestrator  # noqa: E402


def briefs(sd: Path, **files: str) -> Path:
    b = sd / "briefs"
    for name, text in files.items():
        p = b / name.replace("__", "/")
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return b


def run_dirs(sd: Path) -> list[Path]:
    return sorted(p for p in (sd / "runs").iterdir() if p.is_dir())


def test_kept_names():
    assert orchestrator.KEEP_BRIEFS == ("lead.md", "lead-build.md")


def test_end_keeps_lead_briefs_and_moves_the_rest(tmp_path):
    sd = tmp_path / ".superlite"
    sd.mkdir()
    (sd / "pool.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    b = briefs(sd, **{"lead.md": "lead\n", "lead-build.md": "build\n", "fix-F-T1-1.md": "fix\n",
                      "research__R1.md": "r\n"})

    line = orchestrator.end(sd)

    assert line.startswith("orchestrator: run ended; 2 files moved to ")
    (dest,) = run_dirs(sd)
    assert sorted(p.name for p in b.iterdir()) == ["lead-build.md", "lead.md"]
    assert (b / "lead.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "lead\n"
    assert (b / "lead-build.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "build\n"
    assert (dest / "briefs" / "fix-F-T1-1.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "fix\n"
    assert (dest / "briefs" / "research" / "R1.md").is_file()
    assert not (dest / "briefs" / "lead.md").exists()


def test_end_with_only_the_lead_brief_ends_nothing(tmp_path):
    sd = tmp_path / ".superlite"
    briefs(sd, **{"lead.md": "lead\n"})

    line = orchestrator.end(sd)

    assert line.startswith("orchestrator: nothing to end in ")
    assert (sd / "briefs" / "lead.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "lead\n"
    assert not (sd / "runs").exists()


def test_end_without_lead_brief_still_moves_briefs(tmp_path):
    sd = tmp_path / ".superlite"
    briefs(sd, **{"T1.md": "t\n"})

    line = orchestrator.end(sd)

    assert line.startswith("orchestrator: run ended; 1 files moved to ")
    (dest,) = run_dirs(sd)
    assert (dest / "briefs" / "T1.md").is_file()
    assert not any((sd / "briefs").iterdir()) if (sd / "briefs").exists() else True


def test_standing_note_survives_end(tmp_path):
    sd = tmp_path / ".superlite"
    sd.mkdir()
    (sd / "pool.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    briefs(sd, **{"lead.md": f"# Lead brief\n{bb.NOTE_HEAD}\n    keep this line\nEnd.\n", "T1.md": "t\n"})
    before = findings.standing_note(sd)

    orchestrator.end(sd)

    assert before == [bb.NOTE_HEAD, "    keep this line"]
    assert findings.standing_note(sd) == before

"""#784: every prime kind says to edit only under Root and that a dirty git status is the run's normal state."""
import sys

import pytest

from test_plan_tools import SCRIPTS

sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))
import build_prime as bp  # noqa: E402

OWNS = "- Build only what your task owns (its `Owns` files). Never edit other files."
FULL = [
    "- Edit only files under Root (above), by absolute paths that start with Root. A copy of the same file elsewhere "
    "(the main checkout, the folder that holds sl) is not yours, even when your shell's cwd is there.",
    "- `git status` showing files changed against HEAD is the run's normal state (other tasks' and the coordinator's "
    "uncommitted work), never stale files: never revert, restore or stash a file you did not change. `git checkout`, "
    "`git restore` and `git stash` are denied to workers; undo your own edit by editing it back.",
]
MINI = ("- Edit only files under Root, by absolute paths. A dirty `git status` is the run's normal state: never revert, "
        "restore or stash a file you did not change (`git checkout`, `git restore` and `git stash` are denied).")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("pre", [bp.PREAMBLE, bp.PREAMBLE_SLIM])
def test_full_and_slim_carry_both_rules_after_the_owns_rule(pre):
    lines = pre.splitlines()
    i = lines.index(OWNS)
    assert lines[i + 1:i + 3] == FULL


def test_mini_carries_the_short_rule_only():
    lines = bp.PREAMBLE_MINI.splitlines()
    i = lines.index(OWNS)
    assert lines[i + 1] == MINI
    assert FULL[0] not in lines and FULL[1] not in lines


@pytest.mark.parametrize("pre", [bp.PREAMBLE, bp.PREAMBLE_SLIM, bp.PREAMBLE_MINI])
def test_rules_sit_after_the_root_slot(pre):
    assert pre.index("\n\nRules:") < pre.index("Edit only files under Root")
